title: Time Off Approval Form
subtitle: Use this approval to test evidence and authority, resolve conflicts, issue a bounded decision, and verify every resulting update for a time off workflow.
description: An original operational time off approval form that controls a absence request and leave-administration record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the employee, manager, scheduler, or leave administrator needs a traceable approval so the qualified HR, leave, payroll, or policy reviewer can approve, conditionally approve, deny, pend, recode, extend, or route the requested absence under the current leave policy, scheduling rules, payroll controls, confidentiality requirements, and applicable leave obligations without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Time Off approval submission and authority route
sections.guidance: Identify the proposed action, submitter, decision authority, effective point, and required evidence.

blocks.label: Time Off identity
Approval ownership and routing
Approval control
Proposed action, purpose, exact scope, affected people or work, exclusions, and requested conditions

sections.title: Time Off evidence completeness and readiness
sections.guidance: Reject unsupported assumptions before the decision reaches an approver.

blocks.label: Time Off approval readiness
items: Requested dates, hours, and pattern are complete
Qualified reviewer assessed policy and applicable leave requirements
Sensitive documents are routed to a separate restricted record
Balance and pay treatment were verified by an authorized system owner
Manager coverage input is separated from the eligibility decision
Decision and conditions are consistent, specific, and reviewable
Employee communication includes change, extension, and question routes
Payroll, schedule, and leave-administration updates have accountable owners

blocks.label: Evidence package submitted
items: Employee request or absence notice with date and time
Current schedule, shift, or planned work calendar
Leave-policy category and applicable notice template
Balance, eligibility, or timekeeping system reference
Confidential-document receipt status without medical content
Manager coverage plan and operational handoff
Decision communication and employee acknowledgment
Payroll, schedule, extension, cancellation, or return update reference

blocks.label: Required item, evidence, owner, status, and deficiency

sections.title: Time Off policy, authority, and impact review
sections.guidance: Apply the current decision standard and record each reviewer within their actual authority.

blocks.label: Time Off policy and impact checks
items: Requested date, time, duration, and recurrence pattern are internally consistent
Requested policy category matches the information appropriate for this record
Available balance or pay treatment was verified by the system owner
Notice timing and documentation status were reviewed under current policy
Coverage impact is recorded without treating coverage as the sole legal decision
Potential protected leave or accommodation was routed to a qualified administrator
Sensitive medical information is segregated from the routine personnel record
Payroll and scheduling systems can use the approved date and hour boundaries
Conditions, call-in expectations, and update route are specific and feasible
Decision is consistent with comparable requests and documented authority

blocks.label: Review area, reviewer, authority, evidence, finding, and condition
People, schedule, service, cost, payroll, privacy, security, safety, consistency, and system impacts

sections.title: Time Off conflicts, exceptions, and approval conditions
sections.guidance: Resolve material conflicts and convert every condition into owned, verifiable work.

blocks.label: Approval stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the qualified HR, leave, payroll, or policy reviewer under the current leave policy, scheduling rules, payroll controls, confidentiality requirements, and applicable leave obligations.

blocks.label: Time Off exception and escalation triggers
items: Confidential leave or medical information reached an unauthorized recipient
Approved dates, hours, code, or pay treatment were entered incorrectly
Employee, manager, scheduler, payroll, and leave systems show conflicting status
Required notice or decision communication was missed or sent late
Coverage action disclosed information beyond the operational need
Employee reports interference, retaliation, pressure, or discouragement
Return, extension, or recertification routing failed at a critical due point
Absence was denied, rescinded, or changed without the required qualified review

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale
Approval condition, prerequisite, owner, due point, evidence, and expiry

sections.title: Time Off approval decision and effective boundary
sections.guidance: Record one unambiguous decision with rationale, authority, conditions, and review date.

blocks.label: Approval boundary
blocks.guidance: Approval is valid only within the stated scope and authority. The qualified HR, leave, payroll, or policy reviewer must apply the current leave policy, scheduling rules, payroll controls, confidentiality requirements, and applicable leave obligations; a signature does not override a required privacy, safety, security, legal, payroll, tax, or accommodation review.

blocks.label: Approval decision
Evidence relied upon, contrary evidence, alternatives, conditions, limits, and reason for decision
Submission, qualified review, and decision authorization

fields.label: Qualified Hr, Leave, Payroll, Or Policy Reviewer / date

sections.title: Time Off implementation, notification, and approval closeout
sections.guidance: Verify that the approved outcome reached every affected system and recipient.

blocks.label: Approved implementation, system update, notification, and verification
Approval outcome and handoff
Open time off action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Approval accountable review
